# Lumen

Notes that write your summary for you

Lumen keeps your meetings, docs and highlights in one place, then writes the recap you were going to write.

## Features

### Meeting recaps

Joins the call, writes the notes, links the decisions.

### Everything searchable

Ask across every note you ever took.

### Works offline

Your notes open in a second, always.

## Who it is for

Busy managers.

## Pricing

Starts free. Team plans from $29 per month.
